source: AISHA Grant Agreement 101299070, Annex 1, Deliverables descriptions (PDF pp. 93–98) and Milestones means of verification (PDF pp. 99–101)

deliverables.D1.1: Formal charter, membership, decision rules, escalation procedures, and AI Office liaison protocol.
deliverables.D1.2: Operational guidelines, selection criteria, calendars, and first award cycle summary.
deliverables.D2.1: Structured scan and weighted rubric of GenAI education/training across HE, VET, sector programmes; includes inter-rater calibration (κ≥0.70), 6–8 sample programmes scored, reproducibility package and risk note.
deliverables.D2.2: ECTS map, syllabi, assessment blueprints, capstone guidelines, EQF‑referenced modules, workplace tasks, assessment & RPL guidance.
deliverables.D3.1: Type: Report + Datasets + Software. Pan-EU who’s who, who does what and “funding atlas” (EDIHs, Pact for Skills LSPs, Erasmus+, EIT, national/regional) cross-checked with skills-demand signals; sectoral gap-matrix dataset and survey micro-indicators; interactive dashboard with methods note and AP.
deliverables.D3.2: Guidance pack Strategic Skills Outlook (5–10y), sociotechnical module blueprints with legal/ethical/sustainability checklists, CCQF overlay memo.
deliverables.D4.1: Complete curriculum, slides, assessments, micro-credential shells and CCQF tags for ToT1; includes attendance and evaluation report.
deliverables.D4.2: Syllabi, lesson plans, assessments, feedback analysis, and recommendations for scaling; includes gender/inclusion statistics.
deliverables.D4.3: Guidelines, sector workflows mapping, sustainability and data-stewardship modules, evaluation metrics and lessons learned to inform WP5/WP6
deliverables.D5.1: Documentation of implemented vocational schemes and on-the-job training packages in at least five sectors; includes participant numbers, completion rates, and employer feedback.
deliverables.D5.2: Results of the first EU AI apprenticeship cycle: placement numbers, completion rates, post-placement employment outcomes and employer satisfaction analysis.
deliverables.D6.1: Complete curriculum and toolkit for ToT3, including attendance data, gender/inclusion statistics, evaluation summary and updated CCQF tagging.
deliverables.D6.2: Documentation of the third wave of pilot courses: syllabi, teaching/assessment materials, participant and employer feedback, lessons learned and recommendations for packaging and accreditation.
deliverables.D6.3: Outcomes of the third wave of sector labs: lab workflows, advanced GenAI use cases, sustainability and responsible AI modules, integration with DSJP and Hub, and best practices brief for post-grant adoption.
deliverables.D7.1: A comprehensive strategy report (approx. 40–50 pages, English) outlining AISHA’s long-term sustainability model. It will map EU, national, and regional public funding sources; private sector sponsorships; philanthropic opportunities; and fee-based service models. The report will propose a business model for AISHA as a permanent EU Skills Hub, including revenue streams, partnership mechanisms, and funding commitments. An Executive Summary (10 pages, EN) will be made publicly available via the project website and the Digital Skills & Jobs Platform.
deliverables.D7.2: A blueprint (30–40 pages, EN) setting out the design of AISHA’s accreditation model, aligned with EQF/ESCO/ELEVATE standards. It will define competence descriptors, microcredential validation processes, and quality assurance mechanisms. Includes a public summary (10 pages, EN) for dissemination via AISHA’s website and DSJP.
deliverables.D8.1: Indicators, instruments, consent protocols, dashboards design.
deliverables.D8.2: Comprehensive outcomes and policy recommendations from the WP8 experience
deliverables.D9.1: D9.1 positions the GenAI@EU Skills Hub as a one‑stop entry for learners, trainers, employers and policymakers, drives recruitment for courses/apprenticeships, surfaces pilot results for policy uptake, and secures long‑term visibility and partner adoption. The plan is phased (RP1: build & ignite; RP2: scale & convert; RP3: consolidate & handover) and integrates outreach, evidence dissemination and inclusion outreach into a single, measurable programme.
deliverables.D9.2: D9.2 is the mid-term update of AISHA’s Communication and Dissemination Plan in light of the interim results of the activities done till then and the results obtained.
deliverables.D10.1: Procedures, roles, reporting cadence, QA/risk protocols and change control.
deliverables.D10.2: A thorough description of all the KPIs mentioned in this proposal, with evidence of their achievement and motivations in case of any deviation.
